profile_text.body:
The Alignment Research Center, which goes by ARC, is a non-profit research organization founded in 2021 and based in Berkeley, California. Its stated mission is to align future machine learning systems with human interests. The organization describes itself as expecting that new techniques will be needed to align AI systems as they surpass human capabilities, and it argues that progress in AI may accelerate faster than methods can be adapted to keep up. ARC says the field would be better prepared with methods that can be safely scaled across many orders of magnitude, comparing that goal to how generative pretraining and reinforcement learning have been scaled up over the past decade.

The site material does not describe specific products, tools, or named research outputs, and no products are recorded for the company. No lawsuits are recorded against it, and its recorded law exposure is in California.
